# Stakeholders and needs

Needs are the origin of every engineering decision in Aegis IAM.

::: {.need #STK-001 type="stakeholder-need" status="approved" priority="high" tags="security;authentication"}
## Security leadership needs to reduce account takeovers

The CISO needs phishing-resistant authentication for privileged accounts.
:::

::: {.need #STK-002 type="stakeholder-need" status="approved" priority="high" tags="privacy;compliance"}
## Data protection needs control over personal-data exposure

The DPO needs evidence of consent, retention, and least-access practices.
:::

::: {.need #STK-003 type="stakeholder-need" status="approved" priority="high" tags="operations;availability"}
## Operations needs to recover access safely

The support center needs to restore accounts without creating a shortcut for fraud.
:::

::: {.need #STK-004 type="stakeholder-need" status="approved" priority="medium" tags="developer;integration"}
## Product teams need to integrate applications quickly

Internal teams need a standardized interface for login and authorization.
:::

::: {.need #STK-005 type="stakeholder-need" status="approved" priority="medium" tags="audit;governance"}
## Audit needs traceability for access decisions

Auditors need to reconstruct who authorized each privilege and when.
:::
